description: Offer campaigns across brands. With no companyRefs, `mode` is 'top': the offers running across every tracked brand (or one categoryId's brands) in the trailing window, sorted by how many ads carry them, how long they have run, or how deep the discount is. With companyRefs, `mode` is 'calendar': those brands' campaigns in a date window, side by side, for comparing promo timing. Either way offers carried by ads come first, each brand's offer appears once, and at most `limit` come back. Use it for 'what offers are working in this market' and 'when do these brands run sales'. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

categoryId.description: Top offers only. Scope to one industry category's subtree, e.g. the user's brand's: a brand's `category.id` from sightglass_get_company, or an id from sightglass_get_rankings.

companyRefs.description: Company ids or slugs: returns the promo calendar for these brands. Omit for the top offers across every tracked brand.

days.description: Top offers only. Trailing window; defaults to 30.

from.description: Calendar only. YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to six weeks back

limit.description: Most results to return: 20 by default, up to 50. Ones carried by ads come first.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

sort.description: Top offers only. ads = most ads carrying it, running = longest running, depth = deepest discount.

to.description: Calendar only. YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to a week ahead

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_offers
title: Find offers across brands
